```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
output_dir <- normalizePath(params$output_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
read_bundle <- function(name) read.csv(file.path(output_dir, name), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
fixtures <- read_bundle("fixture_results.csv")
coverage <- read_bundle("forecast_coverage.csv")
selected <- read_bundle("selected_forecasts.csv")
ledger <- read_bundle("forecast_ledger.csv")
match_scores <- read_bundle("match_scores.csv")
aggregates <- read_bundle("aggregate_scores.csv")
calibration <- read_bundle("calibration_bins.csv")
advancement <- read_bundle("advancement_scores.csv")
stage_reach <- read_bundle("stage_reach_scores.csv")
headline <- aggregates[
  aggregates$sample == "strict" & aggregates$view == "latest_valid" &
    aggregates$metric == "rps" & aggregates$cut_type == "overall", , drop = FALSE
]
delta <- aggregates[
  aggregates$sample == "strict" & aggregates$view == "paired_delta_latest_minus_first" &
    aggregates$metric == "rps" & aggregates$cut_type == "overall", , drop = FALSE
]
fmt <- function(x, digits = 3) formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "f")
```

# Scorecard

The strict latest-valid benchmark covers **`r headline$n_scored` of 104 fixtures
(`r fmt(100 * headline$coverage, 1)`%)**. Its regulation-time ranked probability
score is **`r fmt(headline$estimate, 4)`**, with a deterministic 95% fixture
bootstrap interval of **`r fmt(headline$lower, 4)` to `r fmt(headline$upper, 4)`**.

The paired latest-minus-first change is **`r fmt(delta$estimate, 4)`** (95%
interval **`r fmt(delta$lower, 4)` to `r fmt(delta$upper, 4)`**). Negative values
favor the latest revision; this interval includes zero.

**Caveats.** Twenty-one fixtures have no strict eligible forecast. Historical
JSON retains only the five leading scorelines, about 46.5% of joint probability
mass, so complete joint and marginal goal-distribution scores are unavailable.
No retained team-stage snapshot predates the opening kickoff; stage-reach results
therefore use strictly pre-stage anchors only. Exploratory evidence is reported
separately and never blended into the strict scorecard.

```{r scorecard-table}
scorecard_metrics <- aggregates[
  aggregates$sample == "strict" & aggregates$view == "latest_valid" &
    aggregates$cut_type == "overall" &
    aggregates$metric %in% c("rps", "brier", "log_loss", "accuracy", "over_2_5_brier", "btts_brier"),
  c("metric", "n_scored", "n_official", "coverage", "estimate", "lower", "upper")
]
knitr::kable(scorecard_metrics, digits = 4, caption = "Strict latest-valid scorecard")
```

# Provenance And Coverage

Every forecast occurrence is tied to its Git commit, archived forecast blob,
dashboard blob, feature-table blob, home and away model blobs, generation time,
committer time, and declared source cutoffs. Strict records require all three
times to be before kickoff with no grace period.

```{r coverage-figure, out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(output_dir, "figures", "forecast_coverage.png"))
```

```{r evidence-table}
evidence_counts <- as.data.frame(table(ledger$evidence_tier), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(evidence_counts) <- c("evidence_tier", "occurrences")
knitr::kable(evidence_counts, caption = "Committed forecast occurrences by evidence tier")
```

# Match Outcomes

RPS is the primary 1X2 metric. Multiclass Brier score and log loss are supporting
proper scores; accuracy is descriptive. Every headline aggregate weights
fixtures equally.

```{r cumulative-rps, out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(output_dir, "figures", "cumulative_rps.png"))
```

```{r revision-figure, out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(output_dir, "figures", "forecast_revisions.png"))
```

# Goals

Over-2.5 and both-teams-to-score probabilities are scored from their archived
market probabilities. Expected-goal errors are diagnostic. Complete joint
scoreline coverage is explicitly zero rather than reconstructed from omitted
cells.

```{r goal-figure, out.width='95%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(output_dir, "figures", "goal_diagnostics.png"))
```

# Advancement And Stage Reach

Knockout targets use the team that advanced, not the regulation-time 1X2 result.
Team-stage probabilities use one deterministic snapshot per stage boundary, so
frequent dashboard revisions do not inflate sample size.

```{r advancement-table}
advancement_summary <- aggregate(cbind(brier, log_loss) ~ sample + view, advancement, mean)
advancement_summary$n <- as.integer(table(interaction(advancement$sample, advancement$view))[
  interaction(advancement_summary$sample, advancement_summary$view)
])
knitr::kable(advancement_summary, digits = 4, caption = "Knockout advancement scores")
```

```{r stage-table}
stage_summary <- aggregate(cbind(brier, log_loss) ~ sample + anchor_type + target_stage, stage_reach, mean)
stage_summary$n_teams <- aggregate(team ~ sample + anchor_type + target_stage, stage_reach, length)$team
knitr::kable(stage_summary, digits = 4, caption = "Anchored team-stage scores")
```

# Calibration

Calibration is shown one class versus the rest. Bins are deterministic quantile
bins; cuts with fewer than five observations are marked sparse.

```{r calibration-figure, out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(output_dir, "figures", "outcome_calibration.png"))
```

# Fixture Ledger

```{r fixture-ledger}
first <- selected[selected$sample == "strict" & selected$view == "first_valid", ]
latest <- selected[selected$sample == "strict" & selected$view == "latest_valid", ]
fields <- c("match_id", "p_home", "p_draw", "p_away", "commit_sha", "generated_at_utc")
first <- first[fields]
latest <- latest[fields]
names(first)[-1] <- paste0("first_", names(first)[-1])
names(latest)[-1] <- paste0("latest_", names(latest)[-1])
fixture_table <- merge(coverage, first, by = "match_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
fixture_table <- merge(fixture_table, latest, by = "match_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
rejections <- ledger[ledger$evidence_tier == "rejected", c("match_id", "primary_reason", "validation_flags")]
rejections <- rejections[!duplicated(rejections$match_id), ]
fixture_table <- merge(fixture_table, rejections, by = "match_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
fixture_table <- fixture_table[match(fixtures$match_id, fixture_table$match_id), ]
stopifnot(nrow(fixture_table) == 104, length(unique(fixture_table$match_id)) == 104)
knitr::kable(fixture_table, digits = 4, caption = "All 104 official fixtures and forecast evidence")
```

## Reproducibility Contract

The report reads only the immutable fixture, ledger, selection, scoring,
calibration, advancement, stage-reach, and checksum artifacts in the evaluation
bundle. It performs no model fitting and does not alter forecast evidence.
